integrity: The proof is self-contained and uses Urysohn's lemma, monotonicity of lattice norms, and an explicit weighted restriction norm; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for real-valued C(K) on compact Hausdorff K.
It concerns equivalent lattice norms, not arbitrary equivalent Banach-space norms.
No computational experiment or independent audit is claimed.
title: \(P\)-points and norm-attainment stability of evaluations on \(C(K)\)
